messages:
Priya Nair: hey team, first-day kubectl weirdness. followed the onboarding kubeconfig steps on WSL but `kubectl describe svc nginx -n infra-tools` returns Forbidden. any quick checks? /cc @DevEx

DevEx: welcome Priya! can you paste `kubectl config current-context` and the exact error? also which KUBECONFIG are you using (WSL tends to have merged files)?

Priya Nair: current-context: redwood-dev
error:
Error from server (Forbidden): services \"nginx\" is forbidden: User \"user:priya@redwood.com\" cannot get resource \"services\" in API group \"\" in the namespace \"infra-tools\"

`kubectl auth can-i get services -n infra-tools` -> "no"
KUBECONFIG: ~/.kube/config:priyamerged (I merged an old laptop config into WSL)

DevEx: two common things: (1) infra-tools access is gated by the Okta group `redwood:infra-tools` OR (2) for day-1 debugging we sometimes grant a short-lived impersonation/debug role so folks can `--as` a service account. which flow do you prefer? we can do a temp RoleBinding for you while People Ops adds the Okta group.

Priya Nair: onboarding doc mentioned an impersonation flow for oncall but didn’t show how to do it. should I be using `--as`? how do we get that permission?

InfraOps: quick approach: we can either (A) add you to `redwood:infra-tools` in Okta (canonical) or (B) apply a temporary RoleBinding in the infra-tools namespace that grants your user the `infra-developer` role. example RoleBinding (infra must apply):
```
apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
kind: RoleBinding
metadata:
  name: onboarding-priya-temp
  namespace: infra-tools
subjects:
- kind: User
  name: "user:priya@redwood.com"
  apiGroup: rbac.authorization.k8s.io
roleRef:
  kind: Role
  name: infra-developer
  apiGroup: rbac.authorization.k8s.io
```
Alternatively, if you want to test impersonation locally we allow `--as` to a limited serviceaccount `infra:debug` but the user needs impersonate permission. that's more secure but takes an extra binding. which do you want?

Priya Nair: temp RoleBinding is easiest for me to keep moving today. thanks.

InfraOps: applied `onboarding-priya-temp` in `infra-tools`, will auto-revoke in 8 hours. try again @Priya Nair.

Onboard Bot: access request updated -> infra temp-binding applied for user priya@redwood.com (ticket 6225).

Priya Nair: confirmed: `kubectl auth can-i get services -n infra-tools` -> "yes" and `kubectl describe svc nginx -n infra-tools` works now. huge help :tada:

People Ops: following up to add you to `redwood:infra-tools` (so temp binding can be removed). expect group sync within 12-24h.

DevEx: thanks Priya 97 we'll add a WSL note to the quickstart about merged kubeconfigs and an explicit blurb for the impersonation vs temp-RoleBinding flows + short YAML snippets. PR incoming. :thumbsup:
